name: Lithium Carbonate
effects: Mood stabilizer — classic first-line for bipolar disorder
Mechanism incompletely understood; modulates inositol signaling, GSK-3β, neuroprotection
Tremor (fine intention tremor), polyuria, polydipsia, cognitive dulling, weight gain
Narrow therapeutic index — toxicity at >1.5 mEq/L: ataxia, confusion, seizure, renal failure
Requires regular serum level, renal, and thyroid monitoring
Antisuicidal properties — strongest evidence of any psychiatric medication
Teratogenic (Ebstein's anomaly — smaller risk than historically stated)
